title: ModelDescriptor
description: A small JSON file, itself an entry of a signed manifest (kind model, mediaType application/vnd.airplanemode.model+json, at most 65536 bytes), that lists the other manifest entries an engine needs (weights, tokenizer, configs, WASM runtime) and how to run them. Never carries a URL; nothing in it is fetched. Files MUST be sorted by path in byte order with unique paths and devices MUST be sorted (both verified outside JSON Schema by validateModelDescriptor / the descriptor loader). Wire format: airplanemode.model/0.1.

spec.description: Wire-format discriminator (major.minor). Consumers reject unknown values.

id.description: Logical model id. Two descriptors (for example one per device) may share it; the manifest entry id is what keys files in the runtime.

engine.description: webllm is reserved and unused until Sprint 3.

devices.description: Execution devices this descriptor supports, unique and sorted ('wasm' before 'webgpu').

dtype.description: Quantisation label, for example q4, q8 or q4f16.

files.description: Sorted by path in byte order; paths unique (verified outside JSON Schema).

runtimeWasm.description: Path, listed in files, of the engine's WASM runtime. Required for transformers-js; the entry behind it has kind wasm.

modelLib.description: Path, listed in files, of the compiled model library. Required for webllm; the entry behind it has kind wasm.

chatTemplateKwargs.description: Extra variables for the chat template, for example enable_thinking false for Qwen3. Keys match the canonical key pattern; values are strings, integers or booleans.

source.description: Provenance only: never fetched, never trusted.

licence.description: SPDX licence expression of the model weights.

Path.description: Relative path, '/'-separated, no leading dot, no '..', no empty segment, no backslash.

entryId.description: Id of a manifest entry of the same manifest as the descriptor.
